summary: The accepted finding reports an aggregate platform usage measure showing that augmentation patterns represent just over half of conversations on Claude.ai, based on a vendor sample. Because no task-specific connection is provided in the finding and aggregate platform statistics do not establish task adoption or workflow shifts for specific data analyst tasks, insufficient evidence exists to evaluate task-specific changes for data cleaning and routine reporting.
